props.headline: Get strong. Stay consistent.
props.body: Coached strength classes of eight people or fewer, an open floor with competition racks, and a programme that tells you exactly what to lift today.

items.title: Small coached classes
items.body: Eight per class, one coach watching your form on every set.

items.title: A plan for every day
items.body: Twelve-week blocks in our app: sets, reps and weights, adjusted weekly.

items.title: Real equipment
items.body: Eight competition racks, calibrated plates and a 40 m turf sled track.

items.title: Physio on site
items.body: A sports physiotherapist on Tuesdays and Saturdays, free for members.

props.heading: Pick how you want to train
props.intro: No joining fee. Pause twice a year for travel or illness.

props.note: Annual memberships get two months free. Students show an ID for 20% off Open gym.

items.question: I have never lifted. Is that a problem?
items.answer: No — most members start that way. Your first three classes are fundamentals: we teach the squat, hinge, press and pull with an empty bar before adding weight.

items.question: What should I bring?
items.answer: Flat shoes, a water bottle and something you can move in. We have towels, chalk and lockers.

items.question: Is there parking?
items.answer: Yes, basement parking for 30 cars and covered two-wheeler parking, free for members.

items.question: Can I freeze my membership?
items.answer: Twice a year, for up to a month each time, from the app. Medical freezes have no limit with a doctor's note.

props.heading: Your first week is free.
props.body: Seven days of classes and open gym. No card, no contract — just turn up at the front desk.
